newsitem.title: UK: European vegetable oils end mixed on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oils end mixed on quiet market.

text.p: Closing European vegetable oil prices were mixed on Tuesday on a quiet market.
Holidays in the Far East and south America kept trading to a minimum during the past few days, but business should start to return to normal on Wednesday with the reopening of the Malaysian markets.
However, traders said the USDA supply and demand report due for release at 1330 GMT on Wednesday may keep some players sidelined.
"Some people may want to see the USDA report before making a start," said one trader.
At the close crude palm oil was $2.50 down to unchanged while products were not quoted.
Coconut oil closed $2.50 to $5 down after Apr/May traded at $750.
Palmkernel oil finished $2.50 down and tradeless.
Soft oils attracted some light trading during the afternoon with Feb soy oil fetching 96.50 and Nov/Jan 100.75 guilders.
May/Jul rape oil traded at 99.75 and 100 guilders per 100 kilos while 100.75 was paid for Aug/Oct fob ex-mill.
Dutch soy oil closed 0.25 guilders down to 0.50 up while rape oil was 0.50 to 0.25 guilders up.
